title: Malta Year 8 Math — Chapters Outline
question: What are the nineteen chapters of Malta Year 8 Math, and which key equations does each chapter use?
intro:
**Section 1 — The nineteen chapters**, in the order they are covered. Chapters 1 to 3 have their own pages, each with many worked examples and a recap quiz.

- Chapter 1: Directed Numbers
- Chapter 2: Number Work
- Chapter 3: Angles
- Chapter 4: Fractions
- Chapter 5: Decimals
- Chapter 6: Percentages
- Chapter 7: Ratio
- Chapter 8: Algebra
- Chapter 9: Sequences
- Chapter 10: Circles
- Chapter 11: Perimeter & Area
- Chapter 12: Surface Area & Nets
- Chapter 13: Graphs
- Chapter 14: Statistics
- Chapter 15: Probability
- Chapter 16: Constructions
- Chapter 17: Transformations
- Chapter 18: Real-life Problems
- Chapter 19: Logo

**Section 2 — Key equations:** one card per chapter. Each card lists the equations and facts the chapter uses, with one quick example under **Show working**.

questions.title: Chapter 2: Number Work
questions.prompt:
- BIDMAS: \(3 + 4\times2 = 3 + 8 = 11\)
- Powers: \(2^3 = 2\times2\times2 = 8\)
- Roots: \(\sqrt{49} = 7\) and \(\sqrt[3]{27} = 3\)
- Prime factors: \(24 = 2^3\times3\)
- \(\text{HCF}(12, 18) = 6\) and \(\text{LCM}(4, 6) = 12\)
- Rounding: \(3.47 \approx 3.5\) (1 decimal place)

**Try:** \(20 - 3\times4\)

questions.title: Chapter 3: Angles
questions.prompt:
- Straight line: \(a + b = 180^\circ\)
- Around a point: \(a + b + c = 360^\circ\)
- Vertically opposite angles are equal
- Triangle: \(a + b + c = 180^\circ\)
- Exterior angle = sum of the two opposite inside angles
- Parallel lines: corresponding and alternate angles are equal; co-interior angles add to \(180^\circ\)

**Try:** two angles on a straight line; one is \(115^\circ\). Find the other.

questions.title: Chapter 4: Fractions
questions.prompt:
- Same denominator: \(\frac{2}{7} + \frac{3}{7} = \frac{5}{7}\)
- Common denominator: \(\frac{2}{3} + \frac{1}{4} = \frac{8}{12} + \frac{3}{12} = \frac{11}{12}\)
- Multiply: \(\frac{2}{3}\times\frac{3}{5} = \frac{6}{15} = \frac{2}{5}\)
- Divide: \(\frac{3}{4}\div\frac{1}{2} = \frac{3}{4}\times\frac{2}{1} = \frac{3}{2}\)
- Mixed number: \(2\tfrac{1}{3} = \frac{7}{3}\)
- Fraction of an amount: \(\frac{3}{4}\) of \(20 = 15\)

**Try:** \(\frac{2}{5}\) of €30

questions.title: Chapter 5: Decimals
questions.prompt:
- Line up the decimal points: \(4.5 + 0.38 = 4.88\)
- \(\times10\) moves every digit one place left: \(0.36\times10 = 3.6\)
- Multiply: \(0.2\times0.3 = 0.06\)
- Fractions as decimals: \(\frac{1}{4} = 0.25\) and \(\frac{1}{3} = 0.333\ldots\)
- Rounding: \(2.68 \approx 2.7\) (1 decimal place)

**Try:** €3.75 + €1.40

questions.title: Chapter 6: Percentages
questions.prompt:
- \(x\%\) of \(A = \frac{x}{100}\times A\)
- \(10\%\): divide by 10; \(50\%\): halve
- \(25\% = \frac{1}{4} = 0.25\)
- Increase by \(p\%\): new amount \(= A\times\left(1 + \frac{p}{100}\right)\)
- Percentage change \(= \frac{\text{change}}{\text{original}}\times100\%\)

**Try:** \(15\%\) of €40

questions.title: Chapter 7: Ratio
questions.prompt:
- Simplify: \(12 : 8 = 3 : 2\)
- Share \(T\) in the ratio \(a : b\): one part \(= \frac{T}{a + b}\)
- Unitary method: 3 for €6, so 1 for €2
- Map scale \(1 : 50\,000\): 1 cm on the map is 500 m

**Try:** share €30 in the ratio \(2 : 3\)
steps:
\(2 + 3 = 5\) parts, one part \(= 30\div5 = 6\):

\[2\times6 = \boxed{12}, \qquad 3\times6 = \boxed{18}\]\n\nThe shares are €12 and €18.

questions.title: Chapter 8: Algebra
questions.prompt:
- Like terms: \(3x + 2x = 5x\)
- Expand: \(3(x + 4) = 3x + 12\)
- Substitute: if \(x = 5\), then \(2x + 1 = 11\)
- Solve: \(2x + 5 = 17 \Rightarrow x = 6\)
- Unknowns on both sides: \(5x - 3 = 2x + 9 \Rightarrow x = 4\)

**Try:** solve \(3x - 4 = 11\)

questions.title: Chapter 9: Sequences
questions.prompt:
- Term-to-term rule: \(5, 8, 11, 14, \ldots\) (add 3)
- \(n\text{th}\) term of that sequence: \(3n + 2\)
- \(n\text{th}\) term \(= d\,n + (\text{first term} - d)\), where \(d\) is the difference

**Try:** the 10th term of \(3n + 2\)

questions.title: Chapter 10: Circles
questions.prompt:
- Diameter \(d = 2r\)
- Circumference \(C = \pi d = 2\pi r\)
- Area \(A = \pi r^2\)
- \(\pi \approx 3.14\)

**Try:** the circumference of a circle with radius 5 cm

questions.title: Chapter 11: Perimeter & Area
questions.prompt:
- Perimeter = all the sides added
- Rectangle: \(A = l\times w\)
- Triangle: \(A = \frac{1}{2}bh\)
- Parallelogram: \(A = bh\)
- Trapezium: \(A = \frac{1}{2}(a + b)h\)

**Try:** the area of a triangle with base 8 cm and height 5 cm

questions.title: Chapter 12: Surface Area & Nets
questions.prompt:
- Cube with edge \(a\): \(SA = 6a^2\)
- Cuboid: \(SA = 2(lw + lh + wh)\)
- Cuboid volume: \(V = lwh\)
- The net of a cuboid has 6 rectangles

**Try:** the surface area of a cube with edges of 3 cm

questions.title: Chapter 13: Graphs
questions.prompt:
- A point \((x, y)\): across first, then up
- Straight line: \(y = mx + c\)
- Gradient \(m = \frac{\text{rise}}{\text{run}} = \frac{y_2 - y_1}{x_2 - x_1}\)
- \(c\) is where the line crosses the \(y\)-axis

**Try:** \(y = 2x + 1\) when \(x = 3\)

questions.title: Chapter 14: Statistics
questions.prompt:
- Mean \(= \frac{\text{sum of the values}}{\text{number of values}}\)
- Median: the middle value, once in order
- Mode: the most common value
- Range = largest − smallest
- Pie chart angle \(= \frac{\text{frequency}}{\text{total}}\times360^\circ\)

**Try:** the mean of \(4, 7, 7, 10\)

questions.title: Chapter 15: Probability
questions.prompt:
- \(P(\text{event}) = \frac{\text{favourable outcomes}}{\text{all outcomes}}\)
- \(0 \le P \le 1\)
- \(P(\text{not } A) = 1 - P(A)\)
- The probabilities of all the outcomes add up to 1

**Try:** the probability of an even number on a fair dice

questions.title: Chapter 16: Constructions
questions.prompt:
- Tools: ruler, compasses, protractor
- A triangle from three sides: the two shorter sides together must be longer than the third (\(a + b > c\))
- An angle bisector splits \(\theta\) into two angles of \(\frac{\theta}{2}\)
- A perpendicular bisector crosses a line at \(90^\circ\) through its midpoint

**Try:** can sides of 3 cm, 4 cm and 8 cm make a triangle?

questions.title: Chapter 17: Transformations
questions.prompt:
- Reflect in the \(y\)-axis: \((x, y) \to (-x, y)\)
- Reflect in the \(x\)-axis: \((x, y) \to (x, -y)\)
- Rotate \(180^\circ\) about the origin: \((x, y) \to (-x, -y)\)
- Translate by \(\binom{a}{b}\): \((x, y) \to (x + a, y + b)\)

**Try:** translate \((2, 5)\) by \(\binom{3}{-4}\)

questions.title: Chapter 18: Real-life Problems
questions.prompt:
- Change = money paid − cost
- Unit price = cost ÷ quantity (the best buy has the lower unit price)
- Speed \(= \frac{\text{distance}}{\text{time}}\)
- Currency: euros \(\times\) exchange rate
- Time: 09:45 to 11:20 is 1 h 35 min

**Try:** two pastizzi and a drink cost €4.65; you pay with a €10 note. Find the change.

questions.title: Chapter 19: Logo
questions.prompt:
- `FD 100` moves forward 100 steps; `BK 50` moves back
- `RT 90` and `LT 90` turn right or left by \(90^\circ\)
- Square: `REPEAT 4 [FD 50 RT 90]`
- Regular polygon with \(n\) sides: turn \(\frac{360^\circ}{n}\) at each corner
- The turns of a closed shape add up to \(360^\circ\)

**Try:** write the commands for a regular hexagon with sides of 50
